name: Wisconsin Winter 2017

venue.details: In the main area of the venue. Please reading Travel page on website for parking instructions.

information:
There will be a 45 person competitor limit for this competition so make sure to register earlier to ensure a spot.

There is also no 3x3 at this competition and we are not adding it to this competition. Keep on the lookout for a Wisconsin Competition with 3x3.
